mapper.select: select p.player_id ,p.name as playerNm ,pt.uniform_num from match_lineup ml join player p on ml.player_id = p.player_id join player_team pt on pt.player_id = p.player_id and pt.team_id = ml.team_id where ml.match_id = #{matchId} and ml.team_id = #{teamId} and ml.is_starting = 1

select p.player_id ,p.name as playerNm ,pt.uniform_num from match_lineup ml join player p on ml.player_id = p.player_id join player_team pt on pt.player_id = p.player_id and pt.team_id = ml.team_id where ml.match_id = #{matchId} and ml.team_id = #{teamId} and ml.is_starting = 0
mapper.insert: insert into match_event( match_id, team_id, player_id, related_player_id, assist_player_id, event_type, minute, extra_minute ) values( #{matchId}, #{teamId}, #{playerId}, #{relatedPlayerId}, #{assistPlayerId}, #{eventType}, #{minute}, #{extraMinute} )
mapper.select: select me.event_id ,me.match_id ,me.team_id ,t.team_nm ,me.player_id ,p.name as playerNm ,me.related_player_id ,me.event_type ,me.minute ,me.extra_minute from match_event me left join player p on me.player_id = p.player_id left join team t on me.team_id = t.team_id where me.match_id = #{matchId} order by me.minute desc, me.created_at desc

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN me.team_id = mg.home_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS homeScore, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN me.team_id = mg.away_team_id THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS awayScore FROM match_event me JOIN match_game mg ON me.match_id = mg.match_id WHERE me.match_id = #{matchId} AND me.event_type = 'GOAL';
